topic: What if you were aboard the Titanic when it struck the iceberg?

scenes.prompt: Medium shot on the wooden deck of a grand ocean liner at dark night under a starlit sky. Cold dark blue water and dim yellow lantern light. The stickman stands on deck looking left in shock, hands on head, mouth wide open with trembling eyes. Right beside the ship railing, a colossal jagged ice mountain rises toweringly out of the ocean.
scenes.narration: What if you were aboard the Titanic when it struck that fatal iceberg?

scenes.prompt: Wide shot cross-section view of the dark ocean line at night. Cold blue underwater lighting. The stickman sits in a small wooden rowboat on the surface, looking tiny. Above water, only a small tip of a huge iceberg is visible, while beneath the water surface, a massive, giant mountain of ice expands far wider and deeper below the stickman.
scenes.narration: Typically, only about one-tenth of an iceberg floats above the water surface.

scenes.prompt: Wide shot of the tilted ocean liner deck slipping into dark sea water at night under moonlight. The stickman stands on the slanted wooden deck looking anxious with hands reaching out. A small group of 5 stickmen crowd frantically around a single small wooden lifeboat, while the vast ship deck around them has far too few boats for everyone.
scenes.narration: The British liner strikes ice and begins foundering in the North Atlantic. The ship carries lifeboats for only one-third of the people on board.

scenes.prompt: Medium shot at the steeply raised stern deck of the sinking ship at night. Cold blue night light and dark sea spray. The stickman clings desperately to a wooden deck railing with wide terrified eyes and screaming mouth as the deck tilts sharply. A small group of 4 stickmen slide down the wood and splash into the freezing black ocean below.
scenes.narration: Many passengers and crew make their last stand on the raised poop deck. Victims are plunged into freezing sea water at minus 2 degrees Celsius.

scenes.prompt: Close shot in the dark freezing sea water at night. Pale blue light with floating ice chunks around. The stickman is submerged to the chest in dark water, shivering violently with wide panicked eyes and open mouth gasping for breath. His thin stick arms hang stiff and motionless in the icy water, unable to stroke or swim.
scenes.narration: Cold shock triggers uncontrolled rapid breathing, gasping, and severe heart strain. Within 15 to 30 minutes, cold incapacitation shuts down limb muscles, preventing swimming.

scenes.prompt: Medium shot inside a small wooden lifeboat floating on dark calm water at night under stars. Soft warm lantern light inside the boat. The stickman sits safely inside the lifeboat, looking relieved yet solemn with quiet eyes. A small group of 3 stickmen sit quietly beside him, rowing gently away across the vast dark sea.
scenes.narration: Would you have found a place in one of the few lifeboats?
